en.headline: Government to gazette plain packaging rules for traditional tobacco products
en.dek: Subsidiary legislation will be published on Friday and take effect on 1 March 2027, with a nine-month transition period ending on 1 December 2027; duty-paid cigarette labels will also be introduced.
body: The government will gazette subsidiary legislation on Friday introducing standardised plain packaging for traditional tobacco products, the Tobacco and Alcohol Control Office of the Department of Health said on Thursday.

The rules will take effect on 1 March 2027 and include a nine-month transition period until 1 December 2027. After the transition, selling non-compliant packaging will carry a maximum fine of HK$50,000 on summary conviction.

Under the new design, cigarette packs will use a drab brown-green colour, display only brand and variant names in prescribed fonts, sizes and colours, and carry updated pictorial health warnings covering at least 85 per cent of the two largest surfaces. Tar and nicotine yield figures will no longer appear. Pack dimensions have been adjusted to cover the vast majority of products on the market.

Director of the Tobacco and Alcohol Control Office Lam Man-chung said the nine-month transition gives the trade ample time to adjust and clear existing stock. He said current packaging still has promotional effect, especially among young people, and that the changes aim to reduce product attractiveness and prevent underestimation of health risks.

The government will simultaneously introduce duty-paid cigarette labels with physical and digital anti-counterfeit features. Overseas experience in 27 jurisdictions and local studies support the measures, officials said.

zh.headline: 傳統吸煙產品統一包裝規定明日刊憲 明年3月生效
zh.dek: 附屬法例周五刊憲，明年3月1日生效，設9個月過渡期至12月1日全面實施；同步引入完稅煙標籤，違規最高罰款5萬元。
body: 政府將於周五刊憲傳統吸煙產品統一包裝設計規定的附屬法例，衞生署控煙酒辦公室周四表示，法例明年3月1日生效，設9個月過渡期，明年12月1日起全面實施。
過渡期後，售賣不符合設計規定的煙包，一經簡易程序定罪，最高可被罰款5萬元。控煙酒辦公室主任林民聰表示，9個月過渡期讓業界有充裕時間調整及消耗存貨。
新規定下，煙包須採用泥棕綠色，只准印上品牌及型號名稱，並按指定字體、大小及顏色展示，圖像健康忠告須覆蓋兩個最大表面面積最少85%。焦油及尼古丁含量標示將取消。煙盒尺寸要求已放寬，涵蓋市面上絕大部分香煙產品。
林民聰指，現時煙包仍有推廣作用，尤其吸引年輕人，或降低公眾對煙草產品危害的判斷。將來的圖像健康警告更具阻嚇力，顯示吸煙相關疾病及對身邊人的影響，並會展示戒煙熱線1833183。
政府會同步引入完稅煙標籤制度，規定每包已完稅煙須附貼具物理及數碼防偽特徵的標籤。當局指統一包裝已在27個國家和地區實施，本地研究亦支持有關措施。
